name: Ishida Mitsunari
source:
Hobby: Researching Battle Tactics
Special Skill: Math
Charm Point: His angelic smile

Hideyoshi's brilliant aide who excels at strategizing. His kind demeanor and effortless sensuality makes him very appealing to wmen. He can get so immersed in analyzing war tactics that he forgets to look after himself.

"I'll always be there for you. That's a promise."

[from the app]
